scope_out: Do not add new external dependencies in this Grain; native credential-store library bindings are deferred to a governed dependency-admission Grain.
Do not advance KX-P02-S06-T02 or P02 phase exit from implementation evidence alone.
Do not auto-grant secret.reveal, do not treat a handle as a bearer credential, and do not add a hidden global secret-access switch.
Do not implement approval UI, organization or team secret sharing, secret rotation UX, or the HTTP egress substitution broker.
Do not store plaintext secrets and do not add KRP fields, core actions, resource authorities, consequence classes, or provider-specific permission models.
